other_conditions: Applicant must be hearing and speech‑impaired
Applicant must have no source of income or means of subsistence
Applicant must not be a habitual beggar
Applicant must not be supported by a son or grandson aged 20 years or above
Applicant must not own property valued over ₹5,000
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 plus free clothing during festivals and free rice as per the nutrition scheme.
